editor.notes: The screen framework's sandbox (UC, D-33): a map as the field (D-pad scrolls it), A opens a list screen over it (fade to black, setup, fade from black; tiled layers, a framed panel, a window, animated icons, a cursor), A there opens a detail screen (a two-frame picture, a scrolling layer), B closes back down the stack and to the field without entering the map again (simple shapes).
